per_scorer.drivers: Massive, armor-like plated musculature. Huge shoulder and trapezius masses with the neck sunk between them. Short, bowed, heavily segmented legs with a bent-knee stance and big blocky feet. Thick forearms and large hands. In profile the back is hunched and the legs zig-zag. A detached fragment beside the profile looks like a tail or appendage, or a model artifact.

Massive, hyper-segmented musculature; very wide shoulders with large deltoid/pauldron-like masses; broad, blocky trunk; wide stance; heavy, lumpy legs; very large feet; profile shows a bent, offset leg line and stray fragments (possibly mesh artifacts)

Massive shoulder/trapezius mass with plate-like shoulders, very broad chest over narrower pelvis, short thick bent legs with huge knees and calves, large hands and wide splayed feet, forward-leaning profile with crouched knees, an extra appendage/fragment near the hip in profile (possible tail or prop)

per_scorer.group_label: hyper-muscular, broad-shouldered, short-legged, big hands and feet, flexed stance
per_scorer.drivers: Massive, heavily segmented muscle masses. Very broad shoulders and a deep V-taper to a narrow waist. Huge fists hanging at mid-thigh. Short, massive legs with bulging calves set in a wide stance. Very large, wide feet with splayed toes. In profile the trunk pitches forward and the knees are bent. The sculpt has knotted, armor-like contours, and a detached fragment floats in front of it in profile.

Massive, heavily sculpted muscle. A very wide, inverted-trapezoid trunk with a deep, forward-thrust chest and hunched back in profile. Thick bowed legs with bulging knees, very large wide feet, big hands, and a short pelvis-to-trunk relation. The profile is irregular, and a stray fragment floats near the hand.

per_scorer.group_label: massive top-heavy brute with oversized hands and feet and a bent-knee stance
per_scorer.drivers: Massive, hypermuscular body; trapezius and shoulder mass rise high; long arms with very large hands hanging at mid-thigh; short, thick legs with heavy calves; very large, wide feet; bent-knee, forward-pitched stance in profile; the back and buttock region is bulky and lumpy. Not just a muscular human: the proportions and joints are reorganized. A detached mesh fragment floats in the profile view.
